title: Vehicle Density at Migration Hotspots
content: Observed vehicle density patterns: Mara River crossings (peak season): Popular crossing points: 15-40 vehicles when crossing in progress. Remote crossing points: 5-10 vehicles. Northern Serengeti crossings: Accessible points: 10-20 vehicles. Remote points: 3-8 vehicles. Calving season (Ndutu area): Peak calving: 8-15 vehicles per sighting. General plains: 3-6 vehicles. Private concessions: Vehicle limits typically 2-6 per sighting. Premium pricing reflects exclusivity. Off-peak migration months (June, October): 40-60% fewer vehicles than August peak.
